messages.text: What are the specs for the power supply supplied

The B.04 pulls about 100 W at the wall, and it ships with a power adapter matched to your plug type (US, EU or UK by address). I don't want to quote you an amperage off memory — tell me your country and I'll confirm the exact adapter rating on the listing.
What is the brand and model number please
Read the hammer miner bc04 page

The listing doesn't name a brand or model for it — all it specifies is a 120 W power supply plus the power cord, feeding a miner that draws about 100 W. I don't want to guess at a part number, so I've passed it to our hardware side; they'll email you the exact PSU make and model, tomorrow from 10am ET.

While that's in motion — anything else about the BC04 I can settle for you, like where you'd run it or what it'd cost you in power?
Before you go, one thing: what's making the power supply the detail you want nailed down before ordering?

These specs should be included in the specification on the website, anyone that is serious about the miners they buy will need this information. Also the constant power usage of 100w on a 120w power supply is not ideal

You're right on both counts, and I've put that to the team with your PSU question. The 100 W is at the wall, so the DC side draw is lower than that headline — but I'm not going to hand-wave it; they'll give you the real rating and margin by email tomorrow from 10am ET.

On another note it is more than annoying when you look at the listing of products and it says it is in stock but when you click on that item it says it is out of stock. If I was a new customer to HD, I would be inclined to stop looking and go elsewhere to buy

Fair hit. Most of the time it's regional: the grid shows the product as stocked, then the page checks your country and the plug/warehouse for your address has none, so it flips to out of stock. It's accurate, but you shouldn't have to click to find out. Which item did it on you? I'll check it live.

Then let's skip the grid. Tell me your country and roughly what you're after — small SHA-256 like the BC04, or something bigger — and I'll tell you exactly what's buyable to your address today, with the ship dates.
Sorry to not have time atm, have work to do. Use your AI skills to check the listing versus regional stock levels
